OSCE AND LEARNING POINTS"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003EOSCE :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETenegliptin :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIt is a third generation DPP-4 inhibitor used for treatment of type 2 diabetes.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMECHANISM OF ACTION of Teneligliptin is to increase incretin levels (GLP-1 and GIP), which inhibit glucagon release, which in turn increases insulin secretion, decreases gastric emptying, and decreases blood glucose levels.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn general incretins (glucagon like peptides) are the substances which increase insulin and decrease appetite by decreasing the gastric emptying. DPP4 dipeptidyl peptide-4 is a enzyme which converts this incretins into its metabolites Which is inhibited by teneligliptin and maintain the levels of incretins which cause insulin release and decreasing the blood glucose levels\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELEARNING POINTS:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMy learning points about this patient are\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E- The importance taking detailed history from the patient before and after the onset of I'll health and how it affected his daily life routine\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-Importance of Mechanism of action of every drug that is prescribed to the patient.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E-Telling the importance of continuous usage
